title: check my defences against AI-driven attacks using what I already have
what: Audit + fixes: /api middleware (per-connection limits, size caps, wrong-key brake, no cross-site writes, no CORS, nosniff/no-store), constant-time owner and ping keys, wider secret masking (asks, miss list, model output), injection rule for every model, agents can't start or answer a send/spend/forget or read the board, a script's click never approves, ?q= links can't start an action, https-only source links, CSP/HSTS/permissions headers; permanent adversarial tests in tools/test_void.mjs; audit in domains/void.defences.md.
note: Records are data. Fresh evidence joining the defences want after this record reopens it.

title: answer with a tiered model stack: a frontier model for hard reasoning, a cheap open model for volume, a tiny classifier for routing
what: lib/router.js in front of /api/answer: @cf/baai/bge-m3 embeddings as a nearest-neighbour classifier over labelled asks (each skill's asks and near-misses, simple and hard questions; example vectors embedded once, kept in memory and the edge cache). Sorts each ask into skill (logged as a skill near-miss for the will), simple (Gemma 4 26B, the default) or hard (Qwen 3.8 27B on the Workers AI free allocation, at most 10 a day; otherwise 'would escalate' is logged as evidence for the stronger-model upgrade; DeepSeek V4 Flash needs paid billing and is never called). Runs alongside the Wikipedia fetch; the answer waits for it at most 300 ms from the start, then falls back to the old behaviour. Decisions in D1 void_routes, owner-only GET /api/routes, read by tools/will.py (source 7). The page and the confirm line are untouched.
note: Records are data. Built on a branch; ships when a builder merges and deploys it. Fresh evidence joining the tiered-model want after this record reopens it; the stronger-model upgrade stays a candidate and gets the router's would-escalate counts.

title: answer with a tiered model stack (router): paid tier added under Atom's rule
what: Atom's rule (STANDING.md, 2026-09-28): the free ceiling is not a stop, but Void pays only from money it has already earned, never from an outside top-up, and every spend needs a yes on the confirm line. The router now sends a hard ask (or an ask the free allowance can't answer) to DeepSeek V4 Flash only when the earned budget is above zero AND an approved standing spend (confirm-line tool models.spend) has room; each call's cost is counted against the cap and the budget and written to void_ledger. Supersedes the earlier record's 'DeepSeek V4 Flash is never called'. Otherwise Qwen 3.8 27B on the free allocation, else Gemma, and 'would escalate' is logged.

title: answer with a tiered model stack (router): one free model, stronger model recorded not called
what: Atom (01:04 ET): until the first Gumroad sale Void stays on free models and a stronger model is recorded, not called; no second fallback stack. Supersedes the earlier records' Qwen 3.8 27B free tier, which is removed. Gemma 4 26B is the one free model (answers and fixes, on by default; VOID_ANSWER_MODELS=off turns it off). A hard ask goes to DeepSeek V4 Flash only when the earned budget is above zero AND an approved standing spend has room; otherwise Gemma answers and one 'would escalate' is counted in void_shortfalls (lib/shortfall.js from PR #1, the one evidence ledger the will and /api/earnings read). When Gemma itself fails, the same paid rule, else the open-web answer (fix: the rules). Worldtime added to the router's labelled set.
